title: A mobile game I’m working on using unity knowledge and claude
author: Arcane-Dev
selftext:
Hey guys! I'm currently working on this mobile game in Unity, and I'd love to hear your feedback!

Recently, I've been focusing on improving the UI. I've integrated Kenney's UI assets, added haptic feedback for vibrations, and refined the scoring system and overall interface to make everything look and feel better.

The game is still in development, so I'd really appreciate your thoughts, suggestions, and feedback. What do you think so far?

comments.author: ContDev
comments.body: haptics are such an underrated thing on mobile, nice call. i'd keep the vibrations super short and subtle and add a toggle in settings tho, some players really hate it lol. also worth watching someone play the first 30 seconds without explaining anything, thats where you find out if the ui actually makes sense

replies.author: Arcane-Dev
replies.body: Thank you for the feedback , yeah the vibration is short and it triggers when collecting each gem and a slitghly longer one for each reward received giving the player a bit of satisfaction for winning the reward , and yeah the vibration toggle is already implemented  , cheers 🥂
